stem: Which of the following is a logical sequence of food chain?
explanation: A food chain starts with producers, which are eaten by consumers; decomposers act on dead remains: Producer → Consumer → Decomposer.

stem: Which of the following is not a type of neuron?
explanation: The three types of neurons are sensory, relay (intermediate) and motor. There is no "respiratory neuron".

stem: A feature of reproduction that is common to Amoeba, yeast and Spirogyra is that
options: [{"label":"A","body":"They reproduce asexually.","is_correct":true},{"label":"B","body":"They are all unicellular.","is_correct":false},{"label":"C","body":"They reproduce only sexually.","is_correct":false},{"label":"D","body":"They are all multicellular.","is_correct":false}]
explanation: Amoeba (binary fission), yeast (budding) and Spirogyra (fragmentation) all reproduce asexually. Spirogyra is multicellular, so (b) and (d) are wrong.

explanation: Shoots grow away from gravity (negative geotropism) and towards light (positive phototropism), so the branches grow straight up.

stem: Which of the following is not derived from solar energy?
explanation: Wind, biomass and most other sources trace back to the Sun. Nuclear energy comes from fission of heavy nuclei. Geothermal heat comes from inside the Earth, so it is also not solar.

stem: Which colour in the spectrum has the lowest dispersion?
explanation: Red light bends (deviates) least and violet the most, so red has the lowest dispersion.

stem: A component used to regulate current without changing the voltage source is called—
explanation: A rheostat is a variable resistor. It changes the resistance, and so the current, without changing the source voltage.

stem: Which metal is used in thermite process?
explanation: In the thermite process, aluminium reduces the oxide of a less reactive metal (e.g. Fe2O3) and releases a lot of heat. It is used to weld rail tracks.

stem: How many covalent bonds are present in pentane?
explanation: Pentane is C5H12. It has 4 C–C bonds and 12 C–H bonds, so 4 + 12 = 16 covalent bonds.

stem: Which of the following proportion is the correct result of Mendel's monohybrid cross?
explanation: In Mendel's monohybrid cross the F2 phenotypic ratio is 3 : 1 (3 dominant to 1 recessive).

stem: When lead nitrate is heated, brown fumes are emitted. Identify the brown fumes.
explanation: 2Pb(NO3)2 → 2PbO + 4NO2 + O2. NO2 is the brown fume.

stem: A person is suffering from hypermetropia. The possible reasons of this defect are: (i) the focal length of the eye lens is more; (ii) excessive curvature of the eye lens; (iii) the eyeball has become too small; (iv) diminishing flexibility of the eye lens.
explanation: Hypermetropia (far-sightedness) is caused by a long focal length of the eye lens (i) or a too-small eyeball (iii). (ii) causes myopia and (iv) causes presbyopia.

stem: Which statements about the modern periodic table are incorrect? (i) It has 18 horizontal rows known as periods. (ii) Electronegativity increases from top to bottom in a group. (iii) It has 7 horizontal rows known as periods. (iv) The effective nuclear charge acting on the valence-shell electrons increases across a period.
explanation: The modern table has 18 groups (vertical columns) and 7 periods (rows), so (i) is wrong. Electronegativity decreases down a group, so (ii) is wrong. (iii) and (iv) are correct.

stem: A metal reacts with dilute HCl to form a metal salt and gas. Which two combinations are correct? (i) Copper — gas evolved: Yes; (ii) Iron — Yes; (iii) Magnesium — No; (iv) Zinc — Yes.
explanation: Metals above hydrogen in the reactivity series (Mg, Zn, Fe) react with dilute HCl and release H2. Copper does not react. So Cu "Yes" and Mg "No" are wrong; Fe and Zn "Yes" are right.

stem: Find the correct sequence in the activity for Ohm's law. (i) Connecting a known resistance; (ii) Connecting a voltmeter across the resistance; (iii) Calculating the resistance; (iv) Calculating the current.
explanation: The activity needs a known resistance, a voltmeter across it, the current measured, and then the resistance calculated (R = V/I). Option (b) is the closest to this order.
